jobs.occupation: Delivery Drivers Wanted – 4 Full-Time Positions at Comvero, Vallensbæk Strand
jobs.description:
Delivery Drivers (Full-Time) – 4 Positions Available

Company: Comvero (CVR 46203909)
Workplace: Vejlegårdsparken 40, 2665 Vallensbæk Strand – driving in the Greater Copenhagen Area and across Denmark
Application Email: job@vejentil.dk
Job Category: Transport / Delivery / Driving
Start Date: As soon as possible

About the Position

Comvero (CVR 46203909) is a transport and delivery company based in Vallensbæk Strand. We are looking for four reliable and motivated Delivery Drivers to join our growing team.

The positions are full-time and involve the safe, efficient and professional transport and delivery of parcels and goods to private customers and businesses. The ideal candidates have experience with transport, delivery or logistics, and are committed to excellent customer service and high safety standards.

As part of our driver team, you will play an important role in ensuring timely and correct deliveries to our customers and business partners.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Daily transport and delivery of parcels and goods to customers and business partners.

• 
Loading and unloading the vehicle safely and efficiently.

• 
Scanning parcels and completing delivery documentation accurately.

• 
Planning efficient routes and adapting to traffic conditions.

• 
Keeping the assigned vehicle clean and roadworthy.

• 
Communicating professionally with customers when required.

• 
Reporting vehicle defects, delays or incidents.

• 
Following Danish traffic laws and company safety procedures.

• 
Cooperating with dispatchers, colleagues and management.

Requirements

• 
Valid Category B driving licence.

• 
Experience as a transport or delivery driver is an advantage.

• 
Ability to lift and handle parcels and goods safely.

• 
Good English communication skills (Danish is an advantage but not required).

• 
Reliable, punctual and service-minded.

• 
Clean criminal record.

• 
Able to work independently and take responsibility.

• 
Physically fit for loading and unloading.

Working Hours

• 
Full-time employment (37 hours per week).

• 
Primarily daytime work.

• 
Overtime is not expected.

Employment Terms

• 
Permanent, full-time position.

• 
Salary according to Danish standards, based on qualifications and experience.

• 
Employment under Danish labour law.

• 
Holiday entitlement and sick leave according to Danish legislation.

• 
Long-term employment opportunities for the right candidates.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short application in English to: job@vejentil.dk

Please do not contact the company directly.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis until all four positions have been filled.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Comvero welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or ethnic background.

jobs.occupation: Project Planning Specialist, Medium Voltage Products
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Product Marketing Manager

__

**What we believe in:

**At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges head-on. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are important drivers in our goal to enable everyone to create sustainable solutions. This is our story. Make it your story.

**Role and tasks

**As Project Planning Specialist, you will combine project planning and control with operational sales administration support within ABB’s Medium Voltage Products business. Working closely with project managers and colleagues across sales administration, engineering, finance, procurement and operations, you will create reliable schedules, maintain accurate SAP data and provide clear insights into project costs, revenue, cash flow, risks and opportunities.

The role is designed with a broad scope. Alongside project planning responsibilities, you will support the sales administration team during peak workload periods and planned absences and help administer project-related financial guarantees. Your work will contribute to reliable project delivery, accurate commercial data and continuity in day-to-day operations. The position is based at our office in Middelfart and follows a hybrid work model.

• Maintaining and improving SAP master data, including material creation, sales item maintenance, product group structures and customer segmentation.

• Developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, including baselines, forecasts, milestones, resources and critical-path activities.

• Monitoring project progress, costs, revenue and cash flow, and providing regular reports and forecasts to the project team and relevant stakeholders.

• Identifying scheduling or cost deviations and working with project managers to define practical corrective actions.

• Creating, administering and maintaining advance payment guarantees, warranty guarantees and other project-related financial securities.

• Providing operational support and backup during peak workload periods and planned absences within the sales administration team.

• Supporting project risk, change, contract and claims management by assessing potential schedule and cost impacts and contributing to mitigation plans.

• Coordinating planning activities with engineering, procurement, finance, customers, contractors and other stakeholders while contributing to improvements in local tools and processes.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• Hands-on experience using SAP for master data maintenance, material creation, sales item maintenance or related sales administration tasks.

• Experience with project planning, project control, project coordination or a related area.

• Ability to develop and maintain project schedules and analyze milestones, dependencies and critical paths.

• Experience monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow or other financial project information.

• Experience with financial guarantees, commercial administration or similar project-related documentation is helpful.

• Familiarity with project risks, changes, contracts or claims is helpful.

• A relevant educational background in engineering, finance, business, project management or another applicable field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Ability to organize information, manage parallel activities and communicate clearly in English; Danish proficiency is an advantage.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You will be based at our office in Middelfart, alongside team members and colleagues. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home a few days a week.

The position reports to Product Marketing Director Morten Hellesøe.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Morten Hellesøe at +4540278387.

The application deadline is 11.11.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

_ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable, and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 110,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 550 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg.

_Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

Run What Runs the World.

#RunWithABB

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.occupation: Project Director, Healthcare – Aarhus
jobs.description:
Project Director, Healthcare – Aarhus

Do you want to take ownership of one of the most strategic and visible programmes in Danish digital health? As Project Director, you will lead a comprehensive, product-strategic initiative for our electronic patient record (EPR) product, which has the potential to become the foundation for international growth. Sounds exciting? Then seize the chance now!

Systematic Healthcare – a coherent healthcare system

Systematics’ healthcare solutions are used by more than 200,000 users in, among others, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands, the UK and New Zealand. Our EPR solution is the core system in a hospital and has been developed in close collaboration with our customers.

Experienced Project Director with ownership, impact and business understanding

As Project Director, you will have overall responsibility for one of Systematics’ most strategic initiatives: an extensive, long-term, product-strategic programme for our EPR product. The programme is closely linked to the EPR solution used in Western Denmark today and is characterised by high complexity, both internally and externally, with many stakeholders including our customers.

The role is not only about delivering on time, price, scope and quality - as our new Project Director, you help create the framework for the program and ensure that both our customers and Systematic realise the expected benefits.

You are the programme’s single point of accountability towards both the steering committee, our customers management and the management in Systematic.

The programme is run as a virtual organisation across tracks such as development, product management, customer projects, implementation and operations. You have no direct reports and therefore create results through influence, trust, clear direction and strong governance. You report to the Vice President for the area and work closely with our customers, Product Management and the leadership of the EPR area.

Your primary tasks will include:

• Owning the programme plan, budget and business case, and ensuring a coherent solution and the expected benefits over the programme’s lifetime.

• Establishing and driving the programme’s governance and acting as the programme’s primary representative towards customer and Systematic management, including preparing and presenting decision papers.

• Actively owning and protecting the scope: challenging new requirements, driving priorities and ensuring an effective change management process.

• Owning the roadmap, schedule, milestones, budget and resource plan, and ensuring proactive risk management with timely escalation to the steering committee.

• Ensuring delivery in accordance with the agreements and leading changes and negotiations together with our Sales and Legal teams and the Vice President.

• Managing a complex stakeholder landscape, internally and externally, including customers and their regional top management, political decision-makers, clinical leadership, partners and internal units, and ensuring that the product roadmap is aligned with the programme’s commitments.

• Building and leading the virtual programme organisation across tracks and departments by setting direction, removing obstacles and being an ambassador for culture and collaboration. At the same time, you support the organisational change that the programme entails

You will be based at our office in Aarhus and can expect customer meetings around Denmark. Your success is measured by whether the programme delivers within the agreed time, price, scope and quality, and whether the benefits of the business case are realised. An important success criterion is the trust of customers and management in the programme.

Your competencies and qualifications

We envision that you have 10–15 years of experience in programme and project management, several of them with large, complex IT programmes of similar complexity: multi-year, with several parallel tracks, many stakeholders and organisational interfaces. You hold a master’s degree, for example in engineering, IT or economics, and ideally a certification in programme management, such as PMI PgMP or Axelos MSP.

In addition, we expect that you:

• Have experience from the IT industry and with public customers, large public contracts and politically governed organisations. Experience from the healthcare sector is a significant advantage.

• Have been responsible for budget, business case and contractual commitments, including negotiating changes with customers.

• Have experience reporting to executive management and steering committees, leading in matrix or virtual organisations without formal line authority, and taking part in organisational change.

• Have a strong understanding of business and finance, as well as experience in contract and risk management.

• Speak Danish as your native language and are fluent in English.

As a person, you:

Take ownership: You act as the owner of the programme, not as an administrator of plans and reports, and you have the courage to say no and make difficult prioritisations.

Lead through influence: You create commitment and results without formal authority.

Have executive presence and political awareness: You are credible at executive level and communicate complex topics clearly and in a balanced way.

Are commercial and customer-minded: You balance customer value with Systematic’s interests and understand the importance of our customers’ work for patients and clinicians.

Are structured, proactive and resilient: You create overview, make decisions on an incomplete basis, and keep your energy and calm throughout a long, high-paced programme.

Are demanding and inclusive: You create an open and honest environment where people are heard and their work is recognised.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Martin Tranekær Rea, VP Healthcare.

jobs.occupation: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Architect the services behind mission-critical C4I capabilities. You'll shape how we turn a robust, commercial-off-the-shelf product into real operational value – acting as a trusted advisor across our international service delivery teams

The job

As Senior Solution Architect, you'll help customers achieve their desired outcomes through standardised service offerings. You'll drive the implementation of our service development strategy and business model, ensuring both commercial success and customer value.

Leveraging our products and global best practices, you'll develop solutions that enhance customer capabilities across their organisations, processes, technology and competences. You'll act as a trusted advisor and key enabler across our service delivery teams, inspiring and supporting local teams as they guide customers to strengthen their capabilities and realise the value of our solutions.

Your key responsibilities:

• Designing service offerings for C4I capabilities that drive customer value and operational effectiveness

• Leading the development of our service catalogue from a technical perspective

• Advising customers on designing and deploying our systems, and defining business and technical requirements together with them

• Creating and maintaining roadmap items that guide the evolution and commercial success of our service offerings

• Advising and inspiring our global constellations to ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across customer engagements

You'll also help adapt military delivery models and standards, develop service descriptions and supporting materials, and contribute to both pre-sales and post-sales activities.

For this role, you should expect occasional business travel of 10-40 days a year, typically in short trips lasting 2-4 days.

Joining the team

You'll report to Marie Lunde Jørgensen, Manager Defence Service Development and work out of our head office in Aarhus or Copenhagen, Denmark. The team brings together expertise in product portfolio management, solution architecture, military domain knowledge, system engineering and business analytics.

The team works strategically to define service concepts, develop business models and shape offerings in close collaboration with global stakeholders across Systematic, while also engaging broadly across the organisation to ensure alignment and drive success.

Your qualifications

• At least 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect within IT systems, product development and bespoke integrations

• A relevant technical bachelor's or master's degree

• Strong expertise in deploying large-scale, complex IT solutions, including cloud, containers and on-premises infrastructure

• Sound understanding of microservices and enterprise architecture principles

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with a talent for advising and influencing with impact

• A structured, detail-oriented and proactive approach to problem-solving in dynamic environments

• Experience in technical or end-user training to support effective knowledge transfer

It would also be an advantage if you bring:

• Familiarity with military IT systems, networks or architecture frameworks, such as NAF, DoDAF or TOGAF

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our office in Aarhus, you can look forward to joining our Employees' Club, which offers nearly 100 social and professional events a year. Here, you can enjoy a range of on-site perks – from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and our own padel court. Our canteen is a particular highlight, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you'll also enjoy benefits such as free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark, with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code that drives progress and improves lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most – and that's why we never stop developing. Here, there's room to be both professional and personal. Systematic isn't just a place to work – it's a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Marie Lunde Jørgensen, Manager Defence Service Development.

jobs.occupation: Specialist for Treasury Products in Wealth Technology
jobs.description:
Do you have hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension and an interest in financial processes across mortgage banking, asset management, risk, regulatory reporting and liquidity management? Join Treasury Products and help develop modern, robust IT solutions.

You will work with core financial processes and contribute to a strategic programme modernising Treasury’s IT landscape, including SimCorp Dimension, integrations and data.

Your role

Nykredit Wealth Technology delivers IT solutions for key financial business areas. Treasury Products supports mortgage banking, proprietary portfolio management, risk, liquidity management and regulatory reporting.

SimCorp Dimension is central to this business-critical value chain. You will work at the intersection of financial products, business processes, data and technology.

You will join a skilled team and collaborate with business units, vendors and colleagues across Wealth Technology.

Help shape the future Treasury platform

The Treasury Greenfield Programme is modernising Treasury’s IT landscape and strengthening the robustness of the value chain across SimCorp Dimension, surrounding systems, integrations and data sources.

Our ambition is to replace the older on-premises platform with a modern, cloud-based SimCorp Dimension SaaS solution and shape the future SCD setup and Treasury it architecture.

As our new Specialist, you will contribute to this transformation, apply your experience and develop your specialist capabilities.

Your primary responsibilities

• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust, flexible IT solutions

• Develop, configure and implement solutions in SimCorp Dimension

• Collaborate with Treasury, Risk and other business areas

• Contribute to the Treasury Greenfield Programme and future platform

• Solve challenges across processes, data and technology

• Maintain solutions and share knowledge across the team.

Your profile

You may come from an IT role involving SimCorp Dimension and financial solutions or from the business side Front Office, Middle Office or Back Office working with Simcorp Dimension. Hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension is required. You do not need to be an expert, but you must have a solid basic understanding of the platform.

In addition, we imagine that you:

• have a relevant background in IT, economics or finance,

• are interested in Treasury, capital markets and technology,

• are curious and motivated to develop your specialist capabilities,

• work in a structured way, take ownership and follow through,

• collaborate well and communicate complex topics clearly.

Your team

You will join a team that values expertise, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We combine different skills and perspectives in a trusting, informal environment where colleagues help and challenge each other.

We expect curiosity, responsibility and an ambition to develop with the team—not that you know everything from day one.

What we offer

We offer a specialist role combining capital markets, mortgage banking, business and technology in an area of significant importance to Nykredit. You can develop your Treasury and SimCorp Dimension expertise while contributing to a strategic transformation. You will work with committed colleagues and take on greater responsibility as your expertise grows.

We also offer competitive employment terms, attractive employee benefits and flexible working conditions.

Want to know more?

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact me, Thomas Skou, Head of Department, at +45 44 55 99 48.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our Recruitment Team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

Your primary responsibilities:

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

Are you the one we are looking for?

We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your new team

You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

About Nykredit Markets

Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

Want to know more?

You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant - Torvehallerne, Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Passionate About Food and Great Service? Join Our Team at Arla Unika

Do you love great food, enjoy connecting with people, and have a passion for creating memorable customer experiences? Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for to join our exclusive cheese shop in Torvehallerne, Copenhagen!

At Arla Unika, cheese is much more than just cheese. Behind every cheese is a story of craftsmanship, innovation, and a dedication to creating exceptional taste experiences. We are passionate about sharing that story with our customers and turning every visit into something special.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and service-minded part-time colleague to join our team.

How you will make an impact

As part of our team, you’ll be the face of Arla Unika, playing an important role in creating exceptional customer experiences. Your job is not simply to sell cheese, but to inspire, guide, and encourage our customers to discover new flavours.

Your daily responsibilities will include providing personal and attentive customer service, advising customers, cutting and wrapping cheeses, and introducing customers to our products through tastings and recommendations.

Together with your colleagues, you’ll help ensure that our shop always looks inviting and that every customer leaves with a great experience and a reason to return.

What will make you successful

We imagine that you

• Have a genuine interest in food and gastronomy and enjoy sharing your enthusiasm with others.

• Are outgoing, approachable, and naturally enjoy connecting with customers.

• Ideally have experience in hospitality or customer service, with previous sales experience being an advantage.

• Can stay calm, positive, and organised, even during busy periods.

• Enjoy an active working environment where physical tasks are part of the day.

• Are responsible, flexible, and always willing to support your colleagues when needed.

• Are curious, eager to learn, and excited to develop your knowledge of cheese, flavours, and gastronomy.

You don’t need to be a cheese expert to join us! What matters most is your willingness to learn, your appreciation for quality food, and your natural ability to make people feel welcome.

What Do We Offer?

At Arla Unika, you’ll become part of a dedicated and supportive team where we share knowledge, help each other, and take pride in delivering outstanding service and gastronomic experiences.

We offer

• An attractive salary package, including pension.

• A dynamic and inspiring workplace in the heart of Torvehallerne, surrounded by food enthusiasts and culinary experiences.

• The opportunity to work with some of Denmark’s most exclusive cheeses.

• Thorough training and the chance to develop your knowledge of cheese, gastronomy, and sales.

• Opportunities to participate in cheese tastings, food festivals, and other exciting events.

• Flexible working hours, with shifts on weekdays and weekends, including afternoons and evenings, making it possible to combine the job with your studies.

Would you like to join us ?

Does this sound like the perfect opportunity for you? We’d love to hear from you!

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact our Store Manager, Becky Nielsen, at beckn@arlafoods.com.

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

Please submit your CV and a short motivation letter through the application link below.

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the Arla Unika team!

We call it Stronger People Stronger Planet and it is deeply anchored in our organisation and founded on our commitment to respecting human rights, increasing access to healthy dairy nutrition, inspiring good food habits, and improving the environment for future generations. In order to succeed we need to hire people with a sustainable mindset. Could this be you?

jobs.description:

• Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure DevOps, GitHub and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

• Understanding of architectural patterns, integration design and modern software engineering practices.

At Arla, we are committed to professional development and empowering our people to grow their careers while making a real impact across the business.

jobs.occupation: Data Scientist Supporting Global Planning - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Do you want to help Arla shape the future of milk planning? Working with advanced forecasting, AI, and optimization, you'll assist in developing innovative solutions that predict future milk supply and optimize how milk is allocated across our global production network.

“In Supporting & Cross Functions within IT & Digital, we partner with Global Trading & Planning, Arla International, and Arla Foods Ingredients. You will become part of a strong and collaborative team working closely with business stakeholders to drive value creation, co-create digital roadmaps and ensure we realize the full value of our digital investments across Arla.__”, says IT Value Partner, Mikkel Nissen.

About the job

You will work with two central solutions supporting Global Planning One Milk Balance and One Intake. One Milk Balance is Arla’s internally developed planning system for balancing raw milk supply with the needs of our dairies. It ensures that incoming milk, fat, and by-products are allocated according to site capacities and business priorities. The solution runs on Azure and integrates with SAP IBP, One Intake, and Power BI.

One Intake is Arla’s next-generation milk intake forecasting solution. Built on Databricks, it uses modern time-series models to improve visibility into future milk supply by combining data science, farmer insights, and supply chain planning. More specifically, you will

• Develop forecasting and optimisation solutions using Python, SQL, Databricks, Azure, and MLOps.

• Support the operational performance of One Milk Balance and One Intake.

• Turn analytical insights into actionable Power BI reporting.

• Work closely with global planners to improve forecasting, planning, and decision-making.

Who are you?

You are curious about how data can solve real business challenges and are motivated by continuously improving forecasting and planning solutions through data and technology. We imagine that you bring most of the following

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics or a related field.

• At least two years of experience as a Data Scientist or in a similar technical role.

• Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Databricks and Azure-based data solutions, including data pipelines, analytics and modelling.

• A strong analytical mindset and business curiosity, with the ability to translate complex data into practical solutions.

• A proactive and collaborative approach, with a motivation to work closely with business stakeholders.

What do we offer?

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of data science, technology and global milk planning, contributing to solutions that help Arla forecast, balance and allocate milk across its global network. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, competitive salary and benefits, and opportunities for professional development.

Would you like to join us?

jobs.occupation: Craftsman CNC
jobs.description:
Do you want to be part of a place where technology, innovation, and professional pride go hand in hand? In our component production, we work with exciting and complex projects – and some of the most demanding materials in the industry. Using the latest technology, we create precision, quality, and world-class solutions.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Our factory is among the most advanced in Europe, featuring fully automated multitask and high-precision 5-axis CNC machining. Here, we constantly challenge ourselves to think differently, develop new processes, and increase capacity through intelligent robotic automation.

We believe in Lean – and that small improvements everyday lead to great results. That’s why we focus on flow, waste reduction, and continuous innovation in everything we do.

With us, you’ll become part of a strong and supportive team where collaboration, well-being, and development – both professional and personal – are at the heart of our daily work.

The position

We are experiencing strong growth and are looking for a skilled and dedicated professional who is passionate about CNC machining and advanced production technology. With us, you’ll work with some of the industry’s most modern and fully automated machines – and continuously develop your skills in an environment where technical expertise, quality, and personal growth go hand in hand.

We’re looking for someone with a keen eye for detail, who takes pride in precision work and sees the job as more than just a paycheck – you thrive when fine-tuning processes, optimizing performance, and achieving perfect results.

Key responsibilities

• Create new programs in Mastercam

• Set up and manage tools using our TMS system

• Program and operate CNC machines based on technical drawings and 3D models

• Monitor and optimize production on fully automated 5-axis milling machines

• Set up, adjust, and fine-tune machines for maximum precision and efficiency

• Ensure consistent high quality through in-machine probing and process control

• Work closely with our engineering team on process optimization and production improvements

• Machine complex components in demanding materials such as 316L, Duplex, and Inconel

• Operate robot-assisted production cells and contribute to advanced automation setups

• Inspect finished parts for tolerances, surface finish, and accuracy

• Maintain a clean, structured, and safe work environment

• Follow all safety and quality standards

What You Can Expect

You’ll join a technology-driven company in growth, where ideas quickly turn into action. We offer an environment with freedom under responsibility, where you have real influence over your workday and opportunities to develop both processes and yourself.

You’ll be part of a self-managing team that takes ownership of planning, quality, and delivery – where professional pride, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of the daily routine.

Here, you’ll have the chance to advance your technical expertise, work hands-on with automation and precision machining, and be part of a workplace where craftsmanship and innovation truly matter.

The candidate

We imagine that you have a background as a toolmaker, industrial technician, or a similar technical education – and that you are motivated by working with advanced production technology at the highest level.

You will become part of an experienced and dedicated team where there is freedom with responsibility, and where we expect you to thrive in a dynamic environment with a wide variety of tasks. You naturally take initiative, contribute with your ideas, and always maintain a strong focus on quality, precision, and continuous improvement.

Your Qualifications

• Experience with CAD/CAM programming – preferably Mastercam

• Solid understanding of machining principles and material properties

• Ability to read and translate technical drawings and 3D models into precise programs

• Strong attention to detail, quality, and process optimization

• Experience in producing complex components in small series

• Familiarity with automation and robotic systems

• Experience with Okuma machines is a strong advantage

• Proficiency in CNC programming languages (e.g., G-code)

• Experience working with various materials, such as stainless steel, Duplex, and PEEK, is an advantage

• A structured and independent work approach, combined with team spirit and professional pride

• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across departments

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

jobs.occupation: Senior OT Incident Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us in this role where you’ll take a leading role in monitoring, triaging, and resolving OT and SCADA incidents across global wind assets. You’ll coordinate incident response across disciplines, drive root cause analysis, and strengthen operational resilience to ensure safe, secure, and reliable energy production. As part of our 24/7 operational setup, you’ll also join an on-duty rotation for one week each month, giving you the opportunity to take ownership when it matters most and help keep our assets running safely and reliably around the clock.

**Welcome to OT Guard & Service Management

**You’ll be part of OT Guard & Service Management where you, together with your colleagues, will support offshore and onshore assets by ensuring stable, secure, and compliant OT and SCADA operations across regions and time zones. You’ll collaborate closely with control rooms, cybersecurity, engineering teams, and suppliers to manage incidents and maintain high operational standards.

As a team, we we collaborate closely, act with integrity, and share knowledge openly to deliver safe, resilient, and high‑performing operations, even in high‑pressure situations.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• monitoring OT system health, security events, and operational alerts across wind assets, substations, and onshore facilities

• triaging and responding to OT and SCADA incidents in close coordination with control room, cybersecurity, and engineering teams

• performing root cause analysis and documenting preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents

• conducting remote diagnostics and coordinating field or supplier interventions when required

• maintaining accurate incident records, handovers, and runbooks to support 24/7 operations

• contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen system resilience, supplier performance, and operational standards.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have experience working with OT or SCADA systems in critical infrastructure environments, or equivalent experience

• understand industrial control system architectures and protocols, such as IEC 60870‑5‑104, Modbus/TCP, DNP3, OPC UA, or equivalent experience

• are confident troubleshooting networks, operating systems, and system integrations in complex OT landscapes

• communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines, regions, and suppliers

• remain structured and calm when handling incidents in changing operational conditions

• hold a degree in engineering, automation, computer science, cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Experience from a similar managing role in a hotel or restaurant.

Flexible and reliable, with a passion for creating great food and experiences.

Turning challenges into opportunities, managing multiple tasks, and keeping high standards, even when things get tough.

Pension, canteen and health insurance

Staff discounts and friends & family rates across our 200+ hotels

Four complimentary hotel nights each year

A 25% discount on food and beverages at our restaurants and bars

jobs.occupation: Global Mobility & Payroll Specialist, Aarhus
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about international assignments, cross-border compliance, and new ways of working? Do you have a keen interest in growing your career in a global company committed to securing the future of sustainable dairy?

If so, this could be the right opportunity for you. Arla Foods’ Global Mobility function is based at Arla’s headquarters in Denmark and consists of dedicated and passionate mobility specialists. Every day, we support colleagues across the globe with all aspects of mobility, from ensuring legal compliance to helping employees and their families settle successfully into new locations.

This is an on-site position based at our headquarters in Viby, Aarhus.

**

How you will make an impact**

The role as Global Mobility & Payroll Specialist is part of a strategic transformation initiative to ensure specialized knowledge in-house for legal compliance within Global Payroll and benefits related to assignments. The role is focused around the framework of managing international compliance within tax, social security and shadow payroll for our cross border assignments.

As part of our team and as a trusted partner to the business, you will have a highly dynamic work life. Together with our team, you will juggle multiple tasks, including

• Support the future development of Global Mobility in Arla

• Support implementation and integration of Global Payroll Processes

• Maintain and support end-to-end delivery of Global Payroll process for assignments

• Act as a trusted advisor to payroll, HR BP, managers, and key stakeholders

• Support key relocations across multiple markets

What will make you successful?

You are a proactive, results-driven professional with a strong stakeholder mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, global environment. You bring experience in Global Mobility and or Global Payroll – especially shadow payroll is an advantage. You possess a “yes-we-can” attitude, are solution-orientated and most importantly; a team player.

Furthermore you

• Have experience in Global Payroll or Global Mobility.

• Bring minimum 4 years of relevant experience within Global Mobility or Global Payroll.

• Awareness of international taxation and social security (A1).

• Strong analytical and structured thinking skills.

• Professional stakeholder management with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Data-driven with the ability to navigate and translate complex data structures into actionable insights; experience with AI is an advantage.

Shape the Future of Dairy

If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Digital Commerce Professional, Arla Denmark - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Would you like to be part of Arla’s digital evolution and take the lead in coordinating and executing impactful retail media and online campaigns across multiple partners? Then you may well be the person we are looking for as our new Digital Commerce Professional in Arla Denmark, based in Viby, Aarhus.

While the gap between online and offline becomes less apparent, product shelves and the shopper experience becomes increasingly digitalized in Denmark. By being part of our Digital Commerce team, you get the chance to make a real difference in Arla’s commercial and digital future.

How you will make an impact

As our new Digital Commerce Professional, you elevate and grow Arla’s digital commerce by collaborating closely with our retailers and colleagues from various functions in a matrix work environment. Your overall responsibility is to drive retail media excellence by coordinating campaigns, stakeholder alignment and asset delivery across brands and retailer partners.

Furthermore, you will also work to ensure digital shelf excellence, helping deliver a strong and shopper-friendly online presence through high-quality product content, data and search visibility on our digital retailer platforms.

Your task will include the following

• 
Coordinate retail media activities together with our Digital Commerce Manager, ensuring timely delivery of campaign materials and alignment between brand teams, retailers and other stakeholders

• 
Drive retail media campaign execution by managing campaign assets, supporting correction and approval processes, and maintaining strong collaboration with internal and external partners

• 
Successfully communicate our digital shelf and content recommendations to retailers and internal stakeholders

• 
Maintain and improve a shopper-friendly digital shelf that grows our retailers’ dairy businesses through strong product presentation, search visibility and content compliance

• 
Maintain and improve product content quality across titles, descriptions, images and related product information to support a best-in-class shopper experience

• 
Monitor digital shelf compliance and KPI development using digital shelf analytics tools, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement

• 
Explore new ways of working within product content, data and retail media by collaborating with customers and internal functions

You should expect regular collaboration with our customers and multiple visits to Fyn (Funen) and Sjælland (Zealand) regions throughout the year. While you are a part of Arla Denmark, you will also be working with our colleagues from our European organisation, but mainly online.

What will make you successful

We imagine that you have a few years of experience within eCommerce, retail media, digital content, sales, or marketing, ideally from a retailer or FMCG environment. Alternatively, you may have gained valuable hands-on experience through a student position with significant responsibilities, where you consistently delivered strong results. You are a proactive and structured coordinator with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to build strong relationships across teams and with external partners, including retailers. Combined with your understanding of digital commerce, retail media, and digital content, you thrive in managing multiple projects simultaneously and ensuring high-quality execution in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. You have excellent communication and presentation skills in English. The position requires native or highly-fluent Danish skills.

If you want to seize this exciting opportunity and become part of Arla’s digital evolution, please apply as soon as possible. We will evaluate applications on an ongoing basis. For additional information, please call Head of Digital Commerce, Cevat Gökce Akin at +45 91311173.

jobs.occupation: Senior Composite Process Technology Manager, FPRT
jobs.description:
Do you know why a composite part fails before it fails? Own the composite process technology in a new, safety-critical production in Vojens and build it from the ground up.

Southern Jutland

Permanent employment

Full time

26-11-2026

Share

Moment Professionals is recruiting on behalf of FPRT a Senior Composite Process Technology Manager for the new composite production in Vojens, Denmark. We are looking for a composite specialist with real depth in the technology who can convert transferred know-how into controlled, scalable and repeatable industrial processes. The role suits you if you want to build a production from the ground up and would rather build processes where little is written down yet than step into a production where everything is already in place.

Your everyday at FPRT

You report to the Chief Production Officer, Composite Manufacturing, and you build and lead the composite technology team of composite process engineers and materials and polymer engineers. You work closely with Production, Quality and NDT, HSE, Maintenance and Engineering, Planning and Supply Chain, and you support the competency and qualification standards for supervisors, technicians and operators together with Production and HR. You are the technical authority for composite manufacturing processes, with the mandate to define process parameters, technical standards and work instructions, and to require technical containment, a process review or a production stop when process integrity, product quality or safety is at risk.

Production starts from an existing process that is being transferred to Vojens, and experienced specialists from the group come to the site to hand it over. You lead the technical transfer and convert it into FPRT-controlled specifications, work instructions, training content and qualification requirements, and you define the technical requirements for equipment, tooling, fixtures, utilities and production conditions through trials, pilot builds and ramp-up. You make sure FPRT has clear local ownership of the critical processes and keeps the technical knowledge for the long term. From day one, you are expected to spot where a step can be done smarter and to have the composite understanding to back that view.

Your time is split between the desk and the floor. You own process flows, critical parameters, material requirements and process-control standards, and you define process qualification, inspection points, acceptance criteria and quality gates together with Quality and NDT. When a process starts to drift, you are the primary escalation point: you go to the floor, lead root-cause analysis, non-conformity investigations and corrective actions, and turn the lessons into updated standards and training. The weight of the role lies in the moulding stage and the material side of the process: resin systems, reinforcements such as carbon fibre, adhesives, curing and the conditions that decide whether porosity and voids are designed out or created. You need a sound grasp of finishing, but your depth is in why a part comes out of the mould as it does.

This is a greenfield site. New buildings are under construction on the site, systems are being selected, and support functions such as maintenance, IT and HR are being built in parallel. In the first period you will help shape how things are done well beyond your own field, and the composite team grows as production scales towards stable serial production.

The role is based in Vojens, and being on site is essential during the build-up. English is the working language in instructions and with colleagues across the group. Danish is a strong advantage in daily life on the floor, and if you are not fluent yet, your willingness to learn it counts.

And then there are the benefits:

Real authority over the processes you own, greenfield impact with no legacy to work around, a professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose, a modern office with gym, sauna and social spaces, and top-of-market compensation for the right experience.

To succeed in the role…

…you do not need to have carried a manager title or to come from defence. What matters is that you know composite technology in depth: why a resin system behaves as it does, what creates strength and what creates defects, and how the environment affects the part. You may come from composite manufacturing in wind energy, marine, aerospace, defence or another high-performance industry, and work today in process or manufacturing engineering, production, materials or as a technical composite specialist. You also take pride in:

• 
challenging an established method, including one handed over by experienced colleagues, and agreeing on a better answer together.

• 
taking ownership and making decisions where little is written down yet.

• 
going to the floor when a process drifts and staying until the root cause is found.

• 
turning know-how into standards, instructions and training that engineers and operators can work from.

• 
developing engineers through technical reviews, coaching and structured problem solving.

What you need to bring:

• 
Either a relevant technical degree or equivalent strong industrial experience, and at least five years in composite manufacturing, process engineering, manufacturing engineering or materials engineering.

• 
Practical experience with industrial manufacturing of fibre-reinforced composite components and thermoset resin systems such as epoxy, phenolic or other thermosets, and hands-on experience with one or more of resin infusion or transfer processes, filament winding, lay-up, moulding, curing, bonding or composite machining and finishing.

• 
A proven track record of developing, transferring, industrialising, qualifying or stabilising manufacturing processes into repeatable production, with a solid grip on process control, documentation, process risk assessment, root-cause analysis, non-conformity handling and technical change management.

• 
Experience leading, mentoring or coaching engineers and production specialists, or acting as their technical authority.

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken. Danish is a strong advantage, or the willingness to learn it.

It is an advantage if you:

• 
come from advanced composite manufacturing in wind energy, marine, aerospace, defence, pressure vessels, automotive or another high-performance application.

• 
have worked with large or structurally critical components, such as aerospace and defence structures, casings, filament-wound products, UAV components or wind turbine blades.

• 
have taken part in a greenfield factory, a new production line, a technology transfer or a major ramp-up.

• 
live within commuting distance of 6500 Vojens, Denmark.

Do you want to join the team at FPRT?

Moment Professionals manages the recruitment process on behalf of FPRT. We review applications continuously and close the process when the right candidate has been found.

The process may include interviews with Moment Professionals and FPRT, relevant tests and reference checks.

Due to the sensitive defense-tech nature of FPRT's projects and operations, all potential employees are subject to a police and intelligence background check as part of FPRT's standard recruitment process. Continued employment is conditional upon obtaining and maintaining the necessary security clearance.

If you are interested, you are very welcome to apply via the application link, and we will assess your application as soon as possible. If you have questions that can help you decide whether the position is right for you, you are welcome to contact Moment Professionals by phone on +45 70 20 18 35 or by email at info@moment.dk. All enquiries are treated confidentially.

The company

FirePoint Rocket Technology (FPRT) is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark: a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. FPRT's ambition is significant: the company is scaling from the early operational phase to 300+ employees within the next 18 months. Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.
